final:
The side-by-side preview shows the original on the left and the optimized model on the right, and they look the same at 1024px. Both outputs are written to `public/models/`, and both pass the fidelity check.

| | Original | `lantern-small.glb` | `lantern-gpu.glb` |
|---|---|---|---|
| File size | 9.56 MB | **221 KB** | 1.53 MB (+260 KB KTX2 decoder) |
| GPU memory (est.) | 85.6 MiB | 21.4 MiB | **3.1 MiB** |
| Load on 4G | 8.8 s | **0.31 s** | 2.07 s (1.59 s download + 0.49 s decode) |
| Textures | 4× PNG 2048² | 4× AVIF 1024² | 4× KTX2 UASTC 768² |
| Fidelity (worst region, SSIM) | 1.0 | 0.900 | 0.912 |

**The trade-off:** the small file is about 7× smaller than the GPU version and loads about 6.7× faster on 4G. The GPU version uses about 7× less GPU memory (3.1 vs 21.4 MiB). The small version is exactly at the 0.90 no-visible-loss limit, while the GPU version has a little more margin.

**Viewer requirements for Babylon.js:**
- `lantern-small.glb` uses meshopt compression and AVIF textures. The tool says Babylon.js 7.10+ loads both automatically, but the browser must support AVIF.
- `lantern-gpu.glb` uses KTX2 textures and needs the KTX2 transcoder. The tool says Babylon.js loads it automatically, but I haven't tested that in Babylon here.

**Notes:**
- Fidelity was measured at 1024px. If the lantern will be shown larger or close up (zoom, VR), I can re-tune with `--view 2048`.
- The search recipes and candidate tables are in `recipes/`. I didn't commit anything.
bash_cmds: pwd; ls -la; ls -la assets public 2>&1; node-assets --help 2>&1 | head -80; ls -l assets/lantern.glb
node-assets inspect assets/lantern.glb --view 1024 --network 4g 2>&1; echo ---; node-assets tune --help 2>&1; echo ---; node-assets optimize --help 2>&1
node-assets tune assets/lantern.glb --for size,gpu --fidelity 0.9 --view 1024 --network 4g --time-limit 5m -o recipes/ 2>&1 | tail -80; echo ---; ls -la recipes/ 2>&1

node-assets tune assets/lantern.glb --for size,gpu --fidelity 0.9 --view 1024 --network 4g --time-limit 9m -o recipes/ 2>&1 | grep -E "size:|gpu:|wrote|results|lantern\.|partial|warnings|limit reached|ktx2|webp" | tail -60

mkdir -p public/models && node-assets run recipes/lantern.size.recipe.toon assets/lantern.glb -o public/models/lantern-small.glb --check 2>&1; echo ---; node-assets run recipes/lantern.gpu.recipe.toon assets/lantern.glb -o public/models/lantern-gpu.glb --check 2>&1; echo ---; ls -l public/models/
